notes.title: Some tips for the game
notes.content:
1. In the basement, a number is displayed for each cat collected
2. In the basement, the keys are on the table
3. In the basement, the enemy attack frequency will not be very fast, you can slow down and think
4. The pistol needs to defeat a certain number of monster cats
